text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Billing: token-emitter mismatch detected for emitter-v2 in us-east-1. High delta between session tokens and emitted usage counts. Triggering incident workflow.

sara_oncall: saw the pager, bootstrapping. attaching dashboards now.

katy_sre: jumping in — metrics show a spike in token_count_emitted vs token_count_processed starting 2024-11-14T02:12Z. emitter-v2 shard 8 shows >20% under-emit.

mike_billing: customer-facing: some enterprise accounts got overage emails. do we know window? which pipeline?

jess_prodops: looks like downstream emitter fan-out to billing-queue had a backlog followed by a drop; kinesis shard split around 02:10 likely caused reorder + duplicate suppression path to drop events.

sara_oncall: initial impact triage: delayed emits for ~47 min, then partial backfill; however some emits never made it to metering-service, so counts are low for a subset — customers may see late-usage or incorrect overage flags.

mike_billing: list of customers with notifications sent: CUST-345, CUST-678, CUST-112. Customer-care already got a ticket batch. tagging them. @customer-care please hold any new overage emails until we confirm. :warning:

customer-care: acknowledged. pausing automated overage email queue. we will send an ack to affected accounts explaining a follow-up.

katy_sre: quick checks: emitter-v2 logs show error "emit_ack_timeout" for messages where dedup-window > 60s. config drift? comparing emitter-v1 we have no errors.

jess_prodops: config push to emitter-v2 earlier today changed dedup_window from 30s -> 90s to reduce duplicates. that explains ack timeouts + interaction with kinesis reorders.

mike_billing: ok that config change likely root cause for under-emits. immediate mitigation options?

sara_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) revert dedup_window to 30s on emitter-v2 (hotfix). 2) trigger manual reconciliation job to rehydrate missing events from raw-ingest for time range 02:05-02:55Z. 3) suppress new overage notifications until reconciliation completes. 4) postmortem owner assignment.

katy_sre: deploying revert to emitter-v2 now. patch command: ```
kubectl set env deployment/emitter-v2 DEDUP_WINDOW=30 --namespace=prod-us-east-1
```

ops-bot: deploy job started (job id: deploy-3372). rolling restart emitter-v2 pods.

incident-bot: NOTE: SLO: billing-report-latency breached. alert severity -> HIGH.

jess_prodops: kicking off reconciliation: job name recon-emit-1777777. it'll scan raw-ingest for messages with session_id present and attempt to re-emit to billing-queue with idempotency. estimated runtime ~45m.

mike_billing: started manual reconciliation. running query to enumerate missing emits: ```
SELECT session_id, COUNT(*) as raw_count, emitted_count
FROM raw_ingest.events r
LEFT JOIN metering.emits e ON r.event_id = e.event_id
WHERE r.received_at between '2024-11-14T02:00:00Z' and '2024-11-14T03:00:00Z'
GROUP BY session_id
HAVING emitted_count IS NULL OR emitted_count < raw_count;
```

katy_sre: revert applied, pods back up. monitoring shows emit error rate dropping to baseline after 60s.

ops-bot: reconciliation job recon-emit-1777777 started at 2024-11-14T03:05Z. progress: 0/12 shards processed.

sara_oncall: customer impact update: likely delayed or missing usage for customers with heavy real-time traffic during window. priority customers flagged for phone outreach: CUST-345 (enterprise-fintech), CUST-678 (ad-platform).

mike_billing: running partial dry-run of recon job for CUST-345 — found ~1.2M missing token emits. queueing re-emits but will rate-limit to avoid upstream throttles.

customer-care: prepping outreach template. need ETA on final reconciliation and whether charges need reversal.

jess_prodops: estimated reconciliation finish ~03:50Z. once re-emits land, billing will run delta-aggregation, then we can decide on billing corrections.

sara_oncall: handoff plan: I'll stay on until final reconciliation completes and basic verification done (~03:50Z). then handing to mike_billing for customer communications and to katy_sre for postmortem/root cause.

mike_billing: ack, taking post-handoff ownership for external comms. will coordinate with legal if any refunds needed.

katy_sre: will own RCA and follow-up: rollback of dedup_window was quick fix but we need a safer rollout policy + canary for emitter config changes that touch dedup/ordering behavior. adding tasks to infra board.

sara_oncall: quick checklist before handoff: - verify recon job completes and emitted_count reconciled - confirm no residual emit errors in last 30m - unpause overage email queue only after billing confirms corrected counts or explicit hold flag set per customer.

ops-bot: reconciliation progress update: 6/12 shards done (50%), ~630k re-emits queued.

incident-bot: Reminder: create incident ticket with tags [billing][metering][emit-dedup-config] and attach timeline.

sara_oncall: created INC-2024-847 in incidents tracker, assigned katy_sre and mike_billing. attaching logs and queries.

mike_billing: recon job finished at 2024-11-14T03:47Z. totals: ~1.9M re-emits across impacted window. delta-aggregation completed at 03:58Z. preliminary find: 99.2% of missing tokens re-emitted successfully.

customer-care: ok to send corrected billing notices? we want to send a single reconciled statement and an apology note.

mike_billing: pause. for CUST-345 we will drop the overage flag and issue a corrected statement. for others with negligible delta, no action. I'll post a short summary to customers and escalate for any refund requests.

katy_sre: RCA notes: root cause = config drift for emitter-v2 dedup_window + kinesis shard split causing reorders. Contributing factor: rollout lacked canary and no schema guard for dedup param changes. Remediation: add canary rollout, add automated alert for "emit_ack_timeout" spike, and a post-deploy traffic replay test.

sara_oncall: handing to mike_billing and katy_sre now. leaving the channel. thanks all for quick triage. :heavy_check_mark:

mike_billing: taking it. will coordinate customer comms and billing corrections.

katy_sre: will draft postmortem + remediation plan. ETA: EOD.

incident-bot: Incident resolved -> status: mitigated. close if no further issues.

mike_billing: closing thread after comms done.
